Definition: of uncertain affinity; dirt, i.e. (morally) depravity:--filth.
BiblicalUsage: Read rhýpos as dirt, that is (morally) depravity. It stands in 1 Peter 3:21: "…like figure whereunto baptism doth also now save…".
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that rhýpos counts, because God put it in his book.
